headline: AUM growth picks up; Credit costs a key monitorable

highlights: We tweak our FY28/ FY29E estimates upward factoring in pick up in growth and normalization of credit costs.
Expect 19/18% AUM growth in FY27/28E: Q2 saw a pick-up in disbursement growth (28% YoY) to INR103.5bn.

Auto sector volumes showed strong growth in H1FY27 in a sharp contrast to the flat to declining sector environment in H1FY26 and supported stronger origination opportunities across most of asset classes and geographies for the company.
AUM mix during the quarter stood at 42.3% / 24.0% / 10.6% / 6.7% for CV / Car / CE and tractor segments respectively.
